# VERA map test fixture

`vera-map-tile.pbf` and `vera-map-tilejson.json` are public OpenFreeMap
responses captured on 2026-08-13 solely for deterministic browser testing.
They preserve the OpenMapTiles source-layer schema used by the vendored Liberty style; VERA's
public listing fixture remains a separate first-party GeoJSON source.

- Source: https://tiles.openfreemap.org/
- OpenFreeMap: https://openfreemap.org/
- OpenMapTiles: https://www.openmaptiles.org/
- OpenStreetMap data: https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright

The product map and its visible attribution continue to credit OpenFreeMap,
OpenMapTiles, and OpenStreetMap contributors.
